title: Correction Is Survivable
compression: Correction is survivable precisely because accuracy matters.
source_reconstruction: A relationship to knowledge can remain continuous while a claim is revised or rejected.
assumption_envelope: Correction is not treated as relational termination.
Accuracy can outrank preservation of a favored claim.
Failed claims remain available as provenance.
decoder_prerequisites: Distinguish correction of a claim from destruction of a relationship.
Distinguish preservation of history from endorsement of a past claim.
candidate_invariants: A claim may change without requiring the inquiry or relation to end.
The path of correction remains recoverable.
cliffs: Do not treat survivable correction as permission to erase the failed claim.
Do not infer that every relationship must survive every correction.
